subject.title: fix(cron): do not set delivery mode to announce when disabling best-effort on payload edits

question: Should `openclaw cron edit <id> --message ... --no-best-effort-deliver` preserve the existing delivery mode instead of continuing to imply `delivery.mode="announce"`?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive CLI delivery contract change; the patch and tests are now coherent, but the final call is whether the explicit false flag should override the shipped announce implication.

options.title: Accept explicit-false semantics
options.body: Merge after maintainer acceptance that `--no-best-effort-deliver` only changes strictness and does not opt a payload edit into announce delivery.

options.title: Preserve shipped implication
options.body: Ask for a revision or close this PR if the old behavior is the intended compatibility contract for both best-effort boolean flags.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit-false semantics
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer acceptance that `--no-best-effort-deliver` only changes strictness and does not opt a payload edit into announce delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent cron create/edit delivery ergonomics history makes this the strongest available owner signal for the compatibility call.
